mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have partly cloudy skies near Badger Ridge Middle School and a beautiful Waxing Crescent moon.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers to support their community programs. Roles involve various physical tasks and require a commitment of two shifts per month, plus a signed confidentiality agreement to protect participant privacy.

Today, you can check out the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Ice Arena is hosting a Girls Try Hockey event.
In a noteworthy call from last Wednesday, officers arrested a 49-year-old man for his fourth O W I after he was observed driving erratically.
Today's flavor of the day is the classic Turtle, but please note that the shop is currently closed. They will open at 10 AM, and tomorrow's flavor will be Mint Cookie.
